stance_basis: transmits state agency reviews without expressing its own position, forwarding both supportive and critical comments from reviewing agencies
summary: The Alabama Development Office served as the state clearinghouse under OMB Circular A-95, coordinating review of the Draft EIS by appropriate Alabama state agencies and transmitting their comments to the Bureau of Outdoor Recreation. The office itself did not express a position on the project, but the attached agency reviews included a recommendation from the Game and Fish Division to prohibit ORV use within National Wildlife Refuges and Wildlife Management Areas, and a comment from an ADO staff member recommending emission control systems on ORVs. The office's role was administrative coordination rather than advocacy.
complaint_summary: The Alabama Development Office, acting as state clearinghouse, transmitted the results of its interagency review of the Draft EIS under OMB Circular A-95, forwarding attached comments from reviewing state agencies including a recommendation to prohibit ORV use within National Wildlife Refuges and Wildlife Management Areas, and a recommendation requiring emission control systems on ORVs.
